_comment: Canonical spatial model of the S.V. Dross. Source of truth for (a) the deck-maps renderer in docs/ and (b) AI image-prompt writing. See setting/ship-layout.md for the human-readable guide. Keep docs/assets/ship.js in sync (it is generated from this file).

ship.name: S.V. Dross
ship.registry: Sovereign Bermudian Reclamation Authority, hull DRS-7749
ship.motto: Recycling the galaxy, one regret at a time.
ship.silhouette: Ugly, wide and flat — roughly disc-shaped (about as wide as long, much less tall): a single-deck blunt HAMMERHEAD BRIDGE perched forward-on-top with outboard sensor/grapple wings and a raked cockpit viewport; a fat rounded-bow habitation/machinery spine; a swollen aft BULB of cargo/reclamation hold; and the ship's one asymmetric feature — a great GARBAGE MAW that is an articulated crab-claw salvage boom off the aft-starboard, folding back to a large rear cargo door. Barnacled with sensor masts and vent stacks. Operational where Ascendance was not.
ship.crew: Skeleton crew, mostly in stasis. Government-issue AI (GLADYS).
ship.tone: Grimy lived-in sci-fi sitcom crossed with deadpan cosmic bureaucracy. Funny first, soft stakes.

coordinate_system.summary: Each deck is a top-down floor plan on its own grid. Decks stack vertically by 'level' (higher level = higher/further forward in the descent).
coordinate_system.deck_grid: Origin top-left of each deck plan. +X = starboard (right). +Y = aft (toward the stern). Fore is at Y=0 (top of the plan). One grid unit = approx 2 meters.
coordinate_system.rect: Every room is rect:{x,y,w,h} in deck-grid units.
coordinate_system.levels: level 3 = Deck A (top, Scene 0) down to level 0 = Deck D (bottom/aft, Scene 3). The party descends one level per scene.
coordinate_system.vertical: Decks are joined by 'connectors' (a forward ladderway/lift, the service crawlspace, and the infection spine). Each connector lists the levels it threads and a forward/aft anchor.
coordinate_system.downstream: Renderers draw rooms from rect on the deck grid and route doors between room edges. Prompt-writers read ambient + entity fields for art direction and relative position ('two decks down, aft of the scrubbers').

style._use: Prepend global_prefix to any location/event prompt for a consistent ship identity.
style.global_prefix: Grimy, lived-in 'used-future' sci-fi aboard a clapped-out working-class garbage barge (NOT a sleek starship). Worn riveted steel bulkheads, exposed conduit and ducting, duct tape, hand-lettered and stenciled labels, coffee rings, decades of grime. Practical/comic register, faint deadpan-bureaucratic humor.
style.lighting: Flickering amber emergency lighting, half-dead fluorescent tubes, glowing teal-green CRT/monochrome readouts, volumetric haze and light steam.
style.materials: Scuffed painted steel, riveted bulkheads, rubber floor matting, yellowed plastic, cable runs; frost and condensation on the lower decks.
style.signage_gag: Where official signage appears, it is aggressively polite Bermudian Authority notices ('We do hope this finds you well') and the odd reference to regulation Bermuda shorts.
style.references: Alien (1979) Nostromo interiors, Red Dwarf, Moon (2009), Silent Running. Comic, not grimdark.
style.negative: No pristine surfaces, no glowing blue holographic UI, no sleek Apple-store minimalism, no clean white walls, no heroic/epic scale, no clean Star Trek bridge.
style.consistency_anchor: Reuse the amber/teal/coral palette and the same grimy materials in every image so the ship reads as one place.

decks.name: Command & Habitation
decks.summary: Top deck. Where the crew wakes from stasis, meets GLADYS, and gets the objective. Cramped, domestic, government-issue.

ambient.lighting: Amber klaxon wash fading to normal; a few dead tubes.
ambient.sound: Hiss of stasis pods venting, GLADYS's chimes, a kettle somewhere.
ambient.smell: Stale recycled air, burnt coffee, the inside of a sleeping bag.

rooms.name: Bridge
rooms.lighting: Forward viewport black with stars; console glow.
rooms.image_prompt: the cramped forward bridge of the garbage barge S.V. Dross: a blunt hammerhead cockpit with a scuffed viewport onto starfield, mismatched analog consoles, a chipped captain's chair with a cushion, hand-labeled switches, a mug left on the dash. Unmanned, autopilot lights blinking amber.

rooms.name: GLADYS Personality Core
rooms.lighting: Soft warm glow, one teal status bank.
rooms.mood: Grandmotherly, humming; a single coral-tinged cable creeping in (spoiler).
rooms.image_prompt: a small humming computer-core closet aboard a grimy barge: a warm amber-lit rack of old server blades and tape reels with a kitschy framed photo of a kettle taped to it, knitted doily on top. Cozy, senile, government-issue. (Warden/spoiler variant: a single pulsing coral-red organic tendril has crept up a duct into the corner.)

rooms.name: Stasis Bay
rooms.lighting: Frosted pod glass underlit, amber klaxon.
rooms.mood: The waking room — Scene 0 starts here.
rooms.image_prompt: a row of open stasis pods venting cold mist in a cramped, grimy crew bay; frost on the glass, tangled monitoring cables, regulation Bermuda-shorts uniforms folded on a bench, a wall sign that reads 'WE DO HOPE THIS FINDS YOU WELL'. Groggy morning-after vibe, flickering amber emergency light.

rooms.name: Holo-Projector Bay
rooms.mood: Bartleby's recharge point (the holo power point).
rooms.image_prompt: a dingy projector alcove with a humming holo-emitter pylon and a worn 'recharge' pad ring on the floor, scuffed warning chevrons, a flickering light-projection of a prim deceased crewman in a blazer standing on it. Comic, slightly sad.

rooms.name: Forward Spine Corridor
rooms.lighting: Flickering strip light and a hand-stencilled deck letter.

decks.name: Mess & Commons
decks.summary: The galley deck. Home of the appliances. Scene 1: Mr. Munch blocks the only door to the scrubber corridor; the coffee machine weeps a clue; an infected dispenser turns hostile.

ambient.sound: Fridge hum, vending-machine jingles, a dripping tap.
ambient.smell: Old fryer oil, burnt coffee, ozone near the bad dispenser.

rooms.name: Mess Hall / Galley
rooms.lighting: Dim greasy strip light, vending-machine glow.
rooms.image_prompt: a grimy ship mess hall / galley at low light: bolted-down tables with chipped laminate, a wall of dented vending machines glowing, a sad coffee station, trays and crumbs, a hand-lettered 'PLEASE BUS YOUR OWN TRAY' sign. One vending machine in the corner is crusted with pulsing coral-red alien growth (Warden/spoiler variant). Cluttered, lived-in, faintly comic.

rooms.name: Rec Nook
rooms.mood: A sagging couch, a dead arcade cabinet.

rooms.name: Scrubber Corridor (to crawlspace)
rooms.mood: The way down. Slime trail leads here.
rooms.image_prompt: a narrow grimy service corridor leading aft and down off a ship mess hall, a single caged bulb, a 'SCRUBBER CONTROL — AUTHORIZED CREW' stencil, a faint glistening slime trail on the floor leading toward a hatch in the deck. Ominous but mundane.

rooms.name: Mess Corridor
rooms.lighting: Flickering strip light and a hand-stencilled deck letter.

decks.name: Service & Machinery
decks.summary: The guts. Scene 2: squeeze through the service crawlspace to the scrubber control, clear the egg-clogged intake, and discover the eggs. The faulty maintenance airlock is planted here.

ambient.sound: Throb of machinery, hissing valves, a wet skittering (spoiler).
ambient.smell: Hot oil, coolant, a sweetish rot under it.
ambient.temp: Hot near the plant, cold near the airlock.

rooms.name: Air Scrubber Control
rooms.image_prompt: a cramped air-scrubber control room aboard a grimy barge: a wall of pipework and filters, a console with a flashing red 'SCRUBBER FAULT' panel, gauges in the red, dripping condensation, a clipboard on a hook. Industrial, oppressive, amber-and-red lit.

rooms.name: Lift-Reactor Plant
rooms.mood: The 'lift' (reclaimite) reactor; warm hum, do-not-touch energy.

rooms.name: Service Crawlspace (duct network)
rooms.image_prompt: the inside of a cramped, hot service crawlspace / duct network aboard a grimy barge: ribbed metal tunnels just big enough to crawl, bundled cables and pipes, dripping condensation, a headlamp cone of light, warning stencils. Claustrophobic. (Warden/spoiler variant: leathery faintly-glowing alien eggs packed into the warm machinery in the dark.)

rooms.name: Maintenance Airlock (FAULTY)
rooms.mood: The gun on the mantelpiece (planted for Scene 3).
rooms.image_prompt: a small grimy maintenance airlock set into a bulkhead, round hatch with a spoked wheel, a blinking yellow warning strobe and a stenciled sign reading 'SEAL FAULTY — DO NOT CYCLE'. Frost around the seal, the black of space beyond a tiny porthole.

rooms.name: Water Reclamation
rooms.mood: Gurgling tanks, a smell best not described.

rooms.name: Service Corridor
rooms.lighting: Flickering strip light and a hand-stencilled deck letter.

decks.name: Cargo & Reclamation Hold
decks.summary: The bottom of the ship and the bottom of the descent. Cavernous, freezing, webbed. Scene 3: the nest, Brood Mama on the salvaged Ascendance pod, and the cargo airlock that ends it.

ambient.lighting: Vast dark, a few failing floods, breath-fog.
ambient.sound: Dripping, a low maternal chittering, the groan of the hull.
ambient.smell: Cold metal, ammonia, something organic and warm under it.

rooms.name: Cargo Hold (the Nest)
rooms.lighting: Failing floods, translucent webbing catching the light.
rooms.image_prompt: a vast, freezing cargo hold aboard a garbage barge, strung with translucent alien webbing and warm clusters of leathery glowing eggs nested into stacked containers and vents; breath-fog, a few failing floodlights, a salvaged gold-trimmed escape pod at the center. B-movie scale, coral-red organic growth against grimy slate steel.

rooms.name: Salvaged Ascendance Escape Pod
rooms.mood: Gold-trimmed, monogrammed, founder-class. The thing they hauled in.
rooms.image_prompt: a derelict founder-class luxury escape pod, gaudy gold trim and a monogrammed crest now scratched and frosted, hatch hanging open, draped in alien webbing, incongruously fancy amid a grimy industrial cargo hold. (The First Exodus billionaires' lifeboat.)

rooms.name: Main Cargo Airlock
rooms.mood: The vacuum solution. Big enough for a forklift-sized horror.
rooms.image_prompt: a large industrial cargo airlock at the aft wall of a freezing hold, a massive round vault door with a teal status ring and a heavy cycle lever, hazard chevrons, the black of space beyond the inner porthole. The obvious way to vent something very large.

rooms.name: Reclamation Bay (rear cargo door)
rooms.mood: The garbage compactor/intake at the stern. Toothy, dormant, flavor (and a tempting hazard).

rooms.name: Hold Gangway
rooms.lighting: Flickering strip light and a hand-stencilled deck letter.

connectors.name: Forward Spinal Ladderway
connectors.note: The main vertical artery: a cramped ladder shaft with a wheezing freight lift, linking all four decks near the bow. The 'normal' route down.

connectors.name: Service Crawlspace Run
connectors.note: The maintenance squeeze the party uses in Scene 2: ducts dropping from the scrubber corridor (Deck B) through the machinery deck (C) and on down into the cargo hold (D). The intimate, dangerous route.

connectors.name: The Infection Spine
connectors.note: PLOT SPINE. A vertical run of warm machinery ducting from the nest in the cargo hold (D) up through the scrubber intake and crawlspace (C), the mess-hall appliances (B), and finally GLADYS's core (A). The nest grows along it: it clogs the scrubbers (the whole problem), seeds eggs in the crawlspace, infects the vending machines, and — if unchecked at 40% O2 — reaches GLADYS's core and turns her into SADYS. Clearing/venting the nest (D) clears the entire spine.

o2_clock.note: Atmosphere/pacing, not a kill timer. Announced by GLADYS at each deck transition. Clearing the nest restores it.

scrubber_loop.fault_source: scrubber-intake choked by nest gunk (via infection-spine from Deck D)
scrubber_loop.fix_partial: clear the intake clog in Scene 2 (slows the drop)
scrubber_loop.fix_full: vent or kill Brood Mama in Scene 3 (clears the clog at the source; air climbs to safe)

power.note: Powers the holo-projector point, doors, lights. SADYS lets upkeep lapse — lights sag, doors hiss open slowly.

systems.infection_path: deck-d (nest) -> deck-c (scrubber intake + crawlspace eggs) -> deck-b (vending machines) -> deck-a (GLADYS core / SADYS)

entities.name: GLADYS
entities.desc: Government-issue ship AI. Warm, grandmotherly, catastrophically forgetful. Becomes SADYS if the infection spine reaches her at 40% O2.

entities.name: Infection Tendril (at the core)
entities.desc: The top end of the infection spine. Only visible/relevant if SADYS fires. A single coral tendril creeping into GLADYS's rack.

entities.name: Stasis Pods
entities.desc: Where the PCs wake. One pod was skipped — Grease's, if used.

entities.name: Holo-Projector / Power Point
entities.desc: Bartleby 'Feathers' recharges here after Hard Light.

entities.name: Mr. Munch
entities.desc: Passive-aggressive snack machine; has rolled across the only door to the scrubber corridor. Solve by change/persuasion/STR.

entities.name: The Weeping Coffee Machine
entities.desc: Inconsolable. Comfort it and it gives the clue: it saw 'the wet thing' drag something shiny down the crawlspace. (Crown & Whisker's kin.)

entities.name: Infected Vending Machine

stats.attacks: hurled cans d6 / electrified grab d8

entities.desc: Crusted with pulsing alien growth. First fight — quick and silly.

states.pre: a dormant grimy vending machine in the corner
states.post: crusted with pulsing coral-red alien growth, lurching to life, hurling cans and arcing electricity

entities.name: Scrubber Console
entities.desc: Flashing FAULT. The objective panel.

entities.name: Scrubber Intake (egg-clogged)
entities.desc: Choked with alien egg-sac gunk. Clearing it (DEX/STR save; K-7 auto) slows the O2 drop — and reveals the eggs.

entities.name: Egg Cluster (crawlspace)
entities.desc: The scare. Dozens of leathery glowing eggs in the warm machinery; one hatches.

entities.name: Scuttler (juvenile alien)
entities.desc: Fast, screechy, more startling than dangerous. Chase-or-squish; the trail ends at the cargo hold.

states.pre: a single leathery alien egg, faintly glowing, twitching
states.post: a fast screechy juvenile scuttler scrabbling out of the cracked egg toward the camera

entities.name: 'SEAL FAULTY — DO NOT CYCLE'
entities.desc: The planted solution. If the party doesn't note it, GLADYS mentions it offhandedly.

entities.name: Salvaged Ascendance Escape Pod
entities.desc: Founder-class First Exodus lifeboat. Brood Mama came aboard inside it. The smoking gun behind Dusty's salvage authorization.

entities.name: Brood Mama

stats.attacks: lashing tongue d8 / acid spew d10 (blast)

entities.desc: Campy googly-eyed maternal horror the size of a forklift. Not, in her view, the villain. Positions to keep the party between herself and any airlock.

entities.name: Nest Webbing & Eggs
entities.desc: Translucent webbing and egg clusters nested into every appliance and vent. The source of the whole infection spine.

entities.name: Egg Clusters (hold)
entities.desc: Warm clusters in the cold hold. One survives for the stinger if you want it.

entities.name: Cargo Airlock Controls
entities.desc: Cycle it with Brood Mama inside to win. K-7 can operate it from inside vacuum unharmed — its moment.

entities.name: Flight Consoles
entities.desc: Mismatched analog flight consoles, hand-labeled switches, autopilot blinking amber.

entities.name: Captain's Chair
entities.desc: Chipped captain's chair with a sad cushion; a mug left on the dash.

entities.name: Forward Viewport
entities.desc: Scuffed blunt-hammerhead viewport onto the starfield.

entities.name: Uniform Bench
entities.desc: Bench of folded regulation Bermuda-shorts uniforms beside the venting pods.

entities.name: Bartleby 'Feathers'
entities.desc: Flickering light-projection of a prim, deceased crewman in a blazer. Helpful, fussy.

entities.name: Vending Wall
entities.desc: A wall of dented, glowing vending machines and a sad coffee station.

entities.name: Mess Tables
entities.desc: Bolted-down tables with chipped laminate; a 'PLEASE BUS YOUR OWN TRAY' sign.

entities.name: Slime Trail
entities.desc: A faint glistening slime trail on the floor leading aft toward the scrubbers.

entities.name: Scrubber Stencil
entities.desc: 'SCRUBBER CONTROL - AUTHORIZED CREW' stencil over a caged bulb.

entities.name: Scrubber Fault Panel
entities.desc: Flashing red 'SCRUBBER FAULT' panel; gauges pinned in the red; dripping condensation.

entities.name: Cargo Vault Door
entities.desc: Massive round vault door with a teal status ring and a heavy cycle lever.

entities.name: Deck Schematic
entities.desc: A grimy framed deck schematic bolted to the bulkhead. Reading it reveals the ship layout (androids know it already).

scenes.title: The Rude Awakening
beats: Get the objective: fix the air scrubbers (down past the mess hall, then the crawlspace)

scenes.title: The Mess Hall Mutiny
beats: Comfort the coffee machine for the clue

scenes.title: The Crawlspace
beats: Note the faulty maintenance airlock (the gun on the mantel)
Trail leads down to the cargo hold

scenes.title: The Nest
beats: The airlock play (lure/shove + cycle; K-7 in vacuum) OR brawl
Win: scrubbers roar back, air climbs to safe

image_events.prompt: Establishing shot: groggy skeleton crew tumbling out of venting stasis pods onto a cold grimy deck under flickering amber klaxon light, mist everywhere, a speaker grille glowing as a grandmotherly AI chimes. Comic morning-after disaster aboard a garbage barge.
A kitschy CRT/monitor on a grimy bulkhead showing GLADYS's screensaver: a slowly rotating photo of a kettle she 'misses', warm amber glow, knitted doily on top of the terminal. Cozy and absurd.

A passive-aggressive snack vending machine has rolled itself across the only doorway out of a grimy mess hall, screen displaying 'PLEASE COMPLETE YOUR TRANSACTION', faint judgmental glow. Bolted tables and crumbs in the foreground. Deadpan comic standoff.
A sad, dented coffee machine on a greasy counter, a single drip like a tear, a hand-written 'TRY THE DECAF :(' note taped to it. Theatrical, inconsolable, comic pathos.
A vending machine crusted with pulsing coral-red alien growth lurching to life, hurling cans and arcing electricity across a grimy mess hall, sparks and amber light. B-movie comic menace, low stakes.

Headlamp reveal inside a hot cramped service duct: pulling away a clot of slime uncovers dozens of leathery, faintly-glowing alien eggs packed into the warm machinery in the dark. Claustrophobic dread, coral glow against greasy steel.
A single alien egg splitting open in the dark of a service duct, a fast screechy juvenile creature scrabbling out toward the camera, motion blur, headlamp light. Startling but small and silly.

Reveal of Brood Mama: a campy, googly-eyed maternal alien the size of a forklift draped over a gold-trimmed salvaged escape pod in a vast freezing webbed cargo hold, surrounded by glowing eggs, breath-fog, failing floodlights. B-movie horror played for warmth and comedy, not grimdark.

Brood Mama tumbling out a massive cargo airlock into the black of space as the vault door cycles, an unbothered service android at the controls inside the vacuum, debris and frost swirling. Triumphant, slightly absurd.

The ship's mood curdles: corridors half-lit, a coral tendril creeping into a warm computer core, the kettle screensaver now grey and still, a door hissing open with a defeated slowness. Melancholy comic gloom, same grimy ship.

Exterior: the drifting garbage barge being tractored into a Crown Reclamation Checkpoint by a prim Bermudian customs vessel; a polite holographic banner reads 'WE DO HOPE THIS FINDS YOU WELL'. An underwriter in pressed Bermuda shorts and knee-high socks waits with a clipboard. Deadpan bureaucratic humiliation.
Final stinger: a single overlooked alien egg behind the coffee machine giving one soft crack, the coffee machine looking thrilled to be a parent. Warm, comic, ominous.

wayfinding._use: Per deck: a PRIMARY route (normal ladderway descent, solid) and where present a SECONDARY route (service-crawlspace dive, dashed), same deck colour. Paths step through room centres and the doorway between consecutive rooms. The line width is a real physical dimension so the top-down map (true scale) and the perspective flavour images agree.
wayfinding.reference: OSHA 4in aisle marking (29 CFR 1910.176); FAA taxiway centreline 6-12in; Dead Space 'Locator' floor line; leveldesignbook.com leading-lines.
wayfinding.design_language: solid = primary (normal/ladderway); dashed = secondary (crawlspace dive); deck-coloured; direction chevrons toward the destination; a terminal descend/exit marker at the connector.

knowledge._use: How the deck layout / item placements become known to the table. Frontend (maps.html) gates by these; flavour images assume the exciting triggers have fired.
knowledge.android_default: K-7 'Kay' (and any android PC) knows the full deck layout from the start.
knowledge.found_map: Reading the 'ship-map' Deck Schematic (commons-a) reveals the layout to everyone.

reveal_states.always: shown once the deck is known
reveal_states.on_enter: revealed when a character enters the room
reveal_states.on_trigger:<event>: revealed when the named image_event fires

exterior._doc: 3D exterior design of the S.V. Dross. Decks A(top,command)->D(bottom,cargo) stack; each deck footprint = the hull cross-section at its height (cargo bulb widest at the bottom, command smallest on top). Drives hull-conformed deck plans + flavour images.
exterior.proportions: Wide, flat, roughly disc-shaped: about as wide as long (a tad longer if needed), and much less tall than wide/long. ~110m L x ~76m beam x ~12m (4 decks).

hammerhead_bridge.what: SINGLE-DECK command bridge superstructure perched forward-on-top (NOT the whole hull cross-section). Teardrop/lens pod: a blunt RAKED forward cockpit VIEWPORT onto the starfield, tapering to a steeper underside and a gentle canopy.
hammerhead_bridge.wings: Outboard SENSOR/SCANNER + GRAPPLE/TRACTOR pods jutting past the hull on both sides — what makes it a hammerhead; they splay out to spot and grab salvage from ahead.
hammerhead_bridge.behind: Deck A habitation (stasis bay, crew quarters, GLADYS core, commons, holo-bay) sits in the hull body behind the bridge.

exterior.hull_body: Fat rounded-bow spine. Decks B (mess/commons), C (service/machinery), D (cargo/reclamation) stack and taper up.
exterior.aft_bulb: Swollen reclamation HOLD — a significant portion of the ship; stores salvage/garbage (the alien nest in-plot), vented to space via the cargo-airlock.

maw.what: The great garbage MAW is an ARTICULATED SALVAGE BOOM — a crab-claw / excavator arm mounted OFF-CENTRE at the aft-starboard. The ship's single asymmetric feature (Millennium-Falcon style).
maw.operation: Swings out from the ship; CUTS/TEARS salvage with a grinder/cutter/plasma-torch head; PULLS the cut pieces in with a flat ELECTROMAGNET grabber; then folds the boom back toward a LARGE REAR CARGO DOOR where the hold consumes (grinds/reclaims) the material.

exterior.symmetry: Symmetric port/starboard EXCEPT the maw boom (the one deliberate asymmetric feature).
